The structure of Li2BiO3 crystallizes in the trigonal space group R3m (No. 160), with a 36-atom unit cell (Li12Bi6O18) distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Bi centers coordinated by six O neighbors, while Li centers show four O neighbors, with O centers having three or four neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner-sharing between Bi octahedra and Li polyhedra, plus edge-sharing between Bi octahedra.
